175534.overview:
GTS Racing Challenge is an arcade racer for handheld platforms. There's a choice between three cars and a number of tracks set in eight different environments. There's a single race mode and several tournament modes. The difficulty could also be changed.

GTS Racing runs a pseudo-3D engine with vehicles displayed as pre-rendered sprites and flat, textured terrain with sprite-based objects along the way. The game supports Graffiti area (for Palm) or hardware buttons for controls, and has full-screen support - but not a separate version - for the Tapwave Zodiac handheld.
